learn.summary: An inductor stores energy in a magnetic field. It resists changes in current.
learn.formula: V = L × di/dt   τ = L / R
tips: At DC, an inductor acts like a wire with a small resistance. This one has 1.5 Ω.
When you open a circuit with an inductor, the voltage can jump very high. A diode across the coil protects the circuit.
